bugs_found_and_fixed.what: theta sign convention bug in rocket-2d.tex SSAnalytical analysis > Forces
bugs_found_and_fixed.detail: Force equations (m r-xddot = -mg cos(theta) + T - A_x, m r-zddot = mg sin(theta) - A_z) assumed theta measured from vertical, contradicting SSFrames' stated (and code-matching, sim/frames.py) theta-from-horizontal convention. Corrected to -mg sin(theta) / +mg cos(theta). Independently re-derived and numerically verified against sim/frames.py's R_body_to_inertial by the architect before applying. Pre-existing user text, flagged during Step 37 prep, now fixed. No code changes needed -- sim/dynamics.py already implements the correct form via to_inertial().

bugs_found_and_fixed.what: point-label swap in rocket-2d.tex SSAnalytical analysis > Moment
bugs_found_and_fixed.detail: Moment equation had C (thrust point) and D (aero reference point) interchanged: read (u_B-u_D)T ... + (l_B-l_C)A_z instead of the correct (u_B-u_C)T ... + (l_B-l_D)A_z. Verified against sim/dynamics.py's _cross_y(aA,...)+aero_moment_y (numeric check: 0.3111 vs 0.8491 for random inputs -- only the corrected form matches the code). Independent of the theta bug (moments taken about B, weight doesn't appear). Propagates mechanically into the static-stability partial derivative and SM formula (l_B-l_C -> l_B-l_D), same structure otherwise. The user's own pre-existing todo ('write that l_C is irrelevant') only holds under the corrected form -- corroborating evidence this was a transcription slip, not an intended convention.

SSCurrent assumptions rewritten to match Steps 36/37 reality (was stale: still claimed constant mass/CoG/I and zero Earth-rotation term).

phase2_5_step37_prep.note: latex/sections/models.tex Non-inertial frame corrections: Omega decomposed in launch tangent-plane frame as function of lat0_deg/azimuth_deg (reusing existing Params fields, no new params). Key finding: in-plane Coriolis is generated entirely by Omega's out-of-plane (y_g) component; in-plane Omega components produce only lateral acceleration a 2D model can't receive -- so the todo's literal phrasing (project Omega onto x_g,z_g) would have kept the half that does nothing. Documented as a closure (not a smallness argument), same precedent as the existing crosswind closure in Section Wind. Consequence flagged: in-plane Coriolis is exactly zero for due-North/South launches (chi=0/180) or at the poles, even though the true effect is maximal there (just lateral). User chose scope Option B over A/C/D via AskUserQuestion: implement in-plane Coriolis (roadmap's original spec) PLUS expose the discarded lateral component as a labeled diagnostic, not fed back into the state -- makes the blind spot visible instead of silent. Also surfaced, not fixed (out of scope): rocket-2d.tex Section Analytical analysis's force equations assume theta measured from vertical, conflicting with Section Frames/actual code (theta from horizontal, nose-up) -- pre-existing inconsistency in user's older text, flagged for a future small fix step.

Lateral (out-of-plane) Coriolis component also computed and exposed as a labeled diagnostic (not fed into the state/physics) per user's Option B scope choice.
